The source page describes the piece as a menu music loop (upbeat electronic:
drums, beats and synthesizers) used in the author's game *3D Sledding*. It was
picked for the BOOT screens because it stays clearly apart from the action-rock
run loop `../super_wreck_roadway_loop.ogg`, so the two never read as the same
piece across the transition into a run.

CC0 does not require attribution; the project nevertheless keeps the credit in
`docs/credits.md`.
